The convertible roof, a defining feature of the Cascada, offers the freedom to enjoy open-air motoring whenever weather permits. The power-operated system makes transitioning between open and closed configurations effortless. Combined with the body-color bumpers and heated exterior mirrors, this vehicle maintains a cohesive, polished appearance whether the roof is up or down.

This vehicle is certified pre-owned, meaning it has undergone a thorough inspection to verify its condition and quality. You can approach your purchase with confidence, knowing that this Cascada has been evaluated to meet specific standards before being placed on our lot.

The interior prioritizes driver and passenger comfort with heated front seats featuring perforated leather trim, allowing you to adjust lumbar support for both the driver and front passenger. The power convertible roof lining, along with climate control features including rear window defroster, ensures comfort in various weather conditions. The sport-themed appointments—including the 3-spoke sport leather-wrapped steering wheel, sport alloy pedals, and magic black interior decor trim—create an upscale environment that reflects the vehicle's performance orientation.

With EPA estimates of 20 city MPG and 27 highway MPG, this 1.6L 4-cylinder engine paired with a 6-speed automatic transmission offers a practical balance of efficiency and capability. The front-wheel-drive configuration contributes to responsive handling, while speed-sensing steering adapts to your driving conditions for a more engaging experience behind the wheel.

We invite you to visit our showroom to see this blue Cascada Sport Touring in person and experience the combination of open-air freedom and modern technology it delivers.

This stunning 2012 Audi A5 2.0T Premium quattro combines sophisticated design with responsive performance, offering you a convertible that delivers both style and capability on every drive.

- 2.0L 4-Cylinder TFSI engine with 8-Speed Automatic transmission and Tiptronic
- quattro all-wheel drive system
- Power convertible roof with wind blocker
- Leather seating surfaces with power-adjustable front seats
- Leather-wrapped steering wheel and shift knob

The A5's 2.0L TFSI engine pairs with the responsive 8-Speed Automatic transmission to provide a smooth driving experience whether you're navigating city streets or enjoying open highway driving. Inside, you'll find a thoughtfully appointed cabin featuring leather seating surfaces and power-adjustable front seats that allow you to find your ideal driving position. The leather-wrapped steering wheel and shift knob add a premium touch, while the sport steering wheel with multiple adjustment options ensures comfortable control. Automatic temperature control keeps the cabin comfortable year-round.

The convertible roof operates at the touch of a button, allowing you to enjoy open-air driving whenever conditions permit. A wind blocker helps minimize buffeting when the top is down. The integrated security system and panic alarm provide peace of mind.

For entertainment and information, the Audi Premium Sound System delivers quality audio through eight speakers, while satellite radio connectivity keeps you connected to your favorite stations. The trip computer displays useful driving data, and steering wheel-mounted audio controls let you manage entertainment without taking your hands off the wheel.

Safety features include dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, a knee airbag, and electronic stability control with traction management. Anti-whiplash front head restraints and power-adjustable front head restraints offer additional protection, while four-wheel disc brakes with ABS provide confident stopping power.

We invite you to schedule a viewing of this E-Class and experience firsthand the combination of luxury, performance, and thoughtful engineering that defines Mercedes-Benz craftsmanship.

OnStar integration adds an extra layer of security and peace of mind.

Safety and convenience features include dual front airbags, ABS brakes, an occupant sensing airbag system, and remote keyless entry. Power windows, power door mirrors, and tilt steering wheel adjust to suit your preferences, while air conditioning and a rear window defroster ensure comfort in any season.

With the 8 ft. long bed, this Super Duty is built around cargo length as much as passenger space, and the overall presence is reinforced by the FX4 Off-Road Package and the added suspension height from the lift.

A Tough Bed spray-in bedliner protects the long bed, while rear splash guards or mud flaps are included to help limit debris behind the rear tires. The 2024 Chevrolet Silverado 2500HD High Country Crew Cab combines heavy-duty hardware with a number of added components that are easy to note in a first look, including a BDS Suspension 5" lift kit with Fox 2.0 shocks and a four-wheel alignment, 22" Fuel Rebel D679 black wheels, 37x12.50R22 Nitto Ridge Grappler tires, and professionally installed window tint with a lifetime warranty. In High Country trim, the cabin is finished with leather seating and includes a head-up display, premium audio, a Wi-Fi hotspot, adaptive cruise control, and a rear camera mirror. The truck is also equipped with collision warning, a power sunroof, roof marker lamps, the High Country Deluxe package, and the Technology Package, giving it a long list of convenience and visibility features without moving away from its work-focused character.

Under the hood and beneath the body, this Silverado carries the equipment expected of a 2500HD with serious towing and hauling intent. It includes the 6.6L Duramax-style heavy-duty diesel setup associated with this trim level, along with the exhaust brake, the 220 amp alternator, the 3.42 rear axle ratio, and the GVWR rating of 11,350 lbs. The truck also has the Federal Emissions Requirements and Engine Block Heater listed among its factory content. Along with the front license plate bracket, capped fuel fill, and winter grille cover, the details are practical and easy to identify as part of a truck intended for regular use in varied conditions.

The chassis and towing equipment add to that focus. This example includes the Z71 Off-Road Package, skid plates, and the LT275/65R20E BF Goodrich Off-Road T/A tires, along with the Gooseneck / 5th Wheel Prep Package and the Gooseneck / 5th Wheel Package. A trailer tire pressure monitor system is also present, which fits with the rest of the towing-related equipment. The combination of these items gives the truck a broad range of factory and added capability, while keeping the description centered on the equipment rather than presentation.

Inside the cab, the Silverado keeps the emphasis on the features that are immediately part of the driving experience. Leather seats, the head-up display, premium audio, and the Wi-Fi hotspot are joined by adaptive cruise control and collision warning. The rear camera mirror, power sunroof, and tinted windows add to the list of visible and usable details, while the High Country trim's appointments continue through the cabin in a way that matches the rest of the truck's specification. description:
This 2024 GMC Sierra 3500HD Denali Ultimate represents a premium heavy-duty truck designed for those who demand capability without compromise. Built on a foundation of strength and sophistication, this truck combines commanding presence with refined amenities that elevate every drive.

- Duramax 6.6L V8 Turbodiesel engine with 10-speed automatic transmission
- 4WD with 2-speed active transfer case
- Gooseneck/5th wheel prep package with hitch platform and bed-mounted trailer harness
- ProGrade Trailering System with integrated trailer brake controller and hitch guidance
- Premium Bose 12-speaker audio system with SiriusXM 360L satellite radio
- 15-inch multicolor head-up display with 13.4-inch premium information display
- HD surround vision with bed view camera and dual trailer camera provisions
- Full grain leather front bucket seats with 16-way power adjustment and lumbar support
- Ventilated and heated front seats with heated rear outboard seats
- Wireless phone projection and charging with Apple CarPlay/Android Auto

The truck's exterior presents commanding styling with the signature Denali grille finished in Vader chrome, LED cargo lighting, and smoked amber roof marker lamps. The gray metallic finish provides a sophisticated appearance that commands attention on any road. Complementing the premium appearance is the spray-on pickup bedliner featuring the Denali logo, protecting your investment while maintaining visual refinement.

Inside, the cabin showcases genuine wood accents on the dashboard and door panels, establishing an atmosphere of upscale comfort. The floor-mounted center console houses dual USB ports for connectivity, while additional charging ports throughout the truck ensure your devices remain ready. Wireless capabilities including phone projection and charging technology integrate seamlessly into modern driving habits.

Advanced trailering features position this truck as a serious workhorse for demanding jobs. The in-vehicle trailering app, hitch guidance with hitch view, and trailer tire pressure monitoring system provide the technology needed for confident hauling. The 3.42 rear axle ratio, 220-amp alternator, and dual 70 amp-hour batteries deliver the mechanical foundation to handle substantial loads.

Safety and convenience technologies are woven throughout every system. Automatic emergency braking, front pedestrian braking, lane departure warning, and rear cross traffic alert provide protective layers during operation. The buckle-to-drive system and safety alert seat add additional peace of mind, while automatic high-beam headlights with rain-sensing wipers optimize visibility in changing conditions.

This truck stands ready to deliver the performance, capability, and luxury you expect from a premium heavy-duty vehicle. Its combination of advanced trailering technology, refined interior appointments, and substantial mechanical capability makes it the right choice for serious truck buyers.

This 2024 Ford F-450SD Limited DRW represents serious capability paired with refined comfort for those who demand both performance and professional presentation.

- FX4 Off-Road Package with Hill Descent Control and off-road tuned shock absorbers
- 6.7L High Output Power Stroke V8 Diesel engine with 10-speed automatic transmission
- Snow Plow Prep Package with supplemental cab heater and computer-selected springs
- SYNC 4 with Enhanced Voice Recognition and Connected Navigation
- B&O Unleashed Sound System by Bang & Olufsen with SiriusXM 360L
- Limited Slip with 4.30 axle ratio
- Heated and ventilated front seats with memory positioning
- Dual rear wheels with 14,000 lb GVWR payload package
- Engine block heater and front wheel well liners pre-installed

- Power-adjustable pedals and auto tilt-away steering wheel
- Dual front and side impact airbags with overhead airbag protection
- 19.5" forged polished aluminum wheels
- Exterior parking camera with rear view

Built on the Super Duty platform, this F-450 delivers the heavy-duty capability serious work demands. The 6.7L diesel engine combines with the proven 10-speed automatic transmission to handle demanding tasks while the 4WD system provides traction in varied conditions. The FX4 Off-Road Package adds genuine capability with hill descent control, specialized suspension tuning, and protective skid plates for transfer case and fuel tank.

The Limited DRW trim ensures your work vehicle doesn't compromise on comfort. Climate control includes front dual-zone air conditioning and rear window defroster, while the supplemental cab heater from the Snow Plow Prep Package extends year-round usability. Memory functions for both the driver's seat and pedals mean your setup is always ready, and the heated steering wheel adds comfort on cold mornings.

Technology integration keeps you connected and informed. SYNC 4 with enhanced voice recognition offers intuitive control, while the Connected Navigation system provides complimentary access for one year. The B&O sound system elevates daily drives, and SiriusXM 360L brings expanded entertainment options to long hours on the road.

Safety features reflect Ford's commitment to protection. Dual front and side impact airbags, an overhead airbag, electronic stability control, and traction control work together to help keep you secure. ABS brakes with dual front and rear disc brakes provide reliable stopping power, and the exterior parking camera assists with rear visibility.

This F-450SD Limited DRW is currently finished in striking white, ready to serve whether your needs involve commercial work, seasonal operations, or dependable daily use. Its combination of diesel power, off-road preparation, payload capacity, and refined interior make it an intelligent choice for serious operators.

Come experience the precision and power that define the Shelby Super Snake.

The MOPAR off-road accessories underscore this truck's capability and distinctive character. The spray-in bedliner protects your cargo area, while the deployable bed step and 18" x 9" bead lock aluminum wheels enhance both functionality and appearance. Special edition badging and two-tone paint create visual impact that commands attention.

This 2024 Ford F-150 Raptor represents the pinnacle of performance and capability for those who demand the best from their truck.

- Twin Panel Moonroof
- B&O Unleashed Sound System by Bang & Olufsen with 14 speakers
- SYNC 4 with Enhanced Voice Recognition and Connected Navigation

The heated steering wheel and ambient lighting create an inviting atmosphere for every journey.

Technology integration is seamless with SYNC 4's enhanced voice recognition and connected navigation system. The B&O Unleashed Sound System delivers premium audio through 14 strategically placed speakers. Bluetooth connectivity, backup camera, and cruise control work together to enhance both convenience and safety during your travels.

Safety stands as a priority with dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, overhead airbags, and an integrated Emergency Communication System through SYNC 4 911 Assist. Lane Departure Warning, Electronic Stability Control, and traction control work proactively to help prevent accidents.

The exterior presents a commanding white finish complemented by 17-inch cast aluminum wheels. Auto high-beam headlights, fog lights, heated power mirrors with turn signal indicators, and rain-sensing wipers provide visibility and convenience. The automatic tilt-away steering wheel and power windows round out the user-friendly design elements.

We invite you to experience this 2024 Ford F-150 Raptor firsthand and discover why it sets the standard for full-size performance trucks.

Distance pacing cruise control with traffic stop-go, your ultimate co-pilot.
Safety and Security
  • Lane departure prevention - Keep it between the lines. It only takes a moment of inattention for your vehicle to drift. Lane departure prevention is an extra level of safety for you and those around you.
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.

Predictive brake assist helps see to it that you stop.

This 2024 Chevrolet Silverado 2500HD ZR2 Bison Edition combines serious capability with purposeful design, ready to handle whatever demands you place on it.

- Duramax 6.6L V8 Turbodiesel with 470 hp and 975 lb-ft of torque
- AEV Steel Bumpers (front and rear) with stamped steel skid plates
- 18" AEV Gloss Black Wheels with Etched ZR2 Logo
- Power Sunroof on Crew Cab
- Technology Package with Rear Camera Mirror and 15" Multicolor Head-Up Display
- Adaptive Cruise Control
- Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium System with SiriusXM 360L
- BOSE Premium 7-Speaker Sound System
- Heated and Ventilated Front Seats with Perforated Leather Trim
- Heated Rear Seats
- Power-Retractable Black Assist Steps with LED Lighting
- Multi-Flex Tailgate
- Gooseneck/5th Wheel Prep Package with Bed Mounted 7-Pin Trailer Harness
- Chevytec Spray-On Bedliner
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto Integration

Built on the ZR2 Bison Edition platform, this truck brings factory-engineered off-road and work capabilities to every drive. The AEV-designed front and rear bumpers, combined with comprehensive skid plate protection, define a vehicle engineered for genuine terrain challenges. Four new tires ensure your investment stays road-ready.

The Duramax diesel engine delivers the torque needed for heavy hauling and towing operations. With 975 lb-ft available at 1600 rpm, you'll find the power accessible across your driving range. The 10-speed automatic transmission responds precisely to your demands, whether navigating city streets or tackling remote terrain.

Your daily driving experience benefits from thoughtful interior design. The heated and ventilated leather seats adapt to changing conditions, while the Infotainment 3 Premium system keeps you connected through Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, and SiriusXM 360L. The 15" Head-Up Display presents critical information directly in your line of sight, reducing distraction during complex driving tasks.

Safety and operational awareness receive serious attention. The Rear Camera Mirror provides expanded visibility, while Adaptive Cruise Control and Rear Cross Traffic Alert work alongside electronic stability control and four-wheel disc brakes to support confident operation in varied conditions.

The Gooseneck/5th Wheel Prep Package transforms this truck into a capable platform for specialized trailers, while the Chevytec bedliner protects your cargo area against the wear of working life. Power windows, locks, and the EZ Lift tailgate add practicality to daily use.

This ZR2 Bison Edition represents a complete package for owners who demand genuine capability backed by engineering integrity.

This 2024 Ford F-350SD Lariat in Silver represents a premium heavy-duty truck built to handle the most demanding work and lifestyle needs with confidence and capability.

- 6.7L High Output Power Stroke V8 Diesel with 10-Speed Automatic transmission and 4WD
- Black Appearance Package with 20" Machined & Ebony Black High Gloss wheels and 6" Ebony Black Angular Running Boards
- FX4 Off-Road Package with Hill Descent Control and off-road specifically tuned shock absorbers
- Twin Panel Power Moonroof with LED Roof Clearance Lights
- Lariat Ultimate Package featuring Pro Trailer Backup Assist and Pro Trailer Hitch Assist
- Head-Up Display for enhanced driving awareness
- Radio: B&O Unleashed Sound System by Bang & Olufsen with SiriusXM 360L and SYNC 4
- Intelligent Adaptive Cruise Control with Stop-and-Go, lane centering, and speed sign recognition
- Electronic-Locking differential with 3.31 Axle Ratio
- Tough Bed Spray-In Bedliner protecting your cargo area
- Power-Deployable Running Boards for convenient entry and exit
- Ford Co-Pilot 360 2.0 with Pre-Collision Assist and Automatic Emergency Braking
- Connected Navigation System with complimentary 1-year trial
- Front Leather-Trimmed 40/Console/40 Seats with heating, ventilation, and power adjustment
- Wireless Charging Pad and dual 68 AH/65 AGM batteries

The truck's engineering reflects Ford's commitment to durability and performance. The High Output Power Stroke diesel delivers the reliability you need for both professional applications and personal adventures. With the FX4 Off-Road Package, you gain Hill Descent Control and specially tuned suspension, making challenging terrain manageable. The transfer case and fuel tank skid plates provide protection where it matters most.

Technology seamlessly integrates into your daily drive. The Head-Up Display keeps critical information in your direct line of sight, while Intelligent Adaptive Cruise Control with lane centering reduces driver fatigue during long stretches. Ford Co-Pilot 360 2.0 includes rear view camera, reverse brake assist, and a comprehensive sensing suite designed to support safer driving. Pro Trailer Backup Assist with trailer reverse guidance simplifies maneuvering, and Pro Trailer Hitch Assist makes trailer hookup straightforward.

Inside, the leather-trimmed front seats offer heating and ventilation for year-round comfort. The B&O Unleashed Sound System delivers premium audio through 14 speakers including a subwoofer. SYNC 4 with Enhanced Voice Recognition provides intuitive control over navigation, communications, and vehicle functions. Six upfitter switches in the overhead console allow customization for specialized equipment needs.

Your investment is protected through Ford Gold Certification, which includes a 172 Point Inspection, 12 Month/12,000 Mile Limited Warranty after the factory warranty expires, and a powertrain warranty extending 84 months or 100,000 miles from the original in-service date. You'll also receive 22,000 FordPass Rewards Points toward your first two maintenance visits and roadside assistance. A $100 warranty deductible applies, and the warranty transfers if you sell the vehicle.

This F-350SD Lariat combines capability, technology, and comfort in a package engineered for those who demand excellence from their truck. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience this vehicle firsthand.

Whether navigating city streets or highway driving, this truck achieves 14 city MPG and 18 highway MPG, providing respectable efficiency for a vehicle of this caliber.

The interior showcases sophisticated design with leather-trimmed front bucket seats that offer heating and ventilation for year-round comfort. Memory functions for both the driver's seat and steering wheel position personalize your driving experience, while the heated rear seats ensure all passengers travel in comfort. The leather-wrapped steering wheel with mounted audio controls keeps command at your fingertips, and the convenient heated steering wheel is perfect for cold mornings.

Technology integration is seamless with SYNC 4 connectivity featuring a 5G modem and one-year Ford Connectivity Package inclusion. The Connected Navigation system keeps you on course, while the 911 Assist emergency communication system provides added peace of mind. The B&O Unleashed Sound System by Bang & Olufsen elevates every drive with premium audio quality, and SiriusXM with 360L access expands your entertainment options.

Safety features are comprehensive, including dual front and side impact airbags, overhead airbags, electronic stability control, and traction control. The electronic stability control system works intelligently to maintain vehicle control, while the lane departure warning system provides an extra layer of awareness. Anti-lock brakes with brake assist and four-wheel disc brakes deliver responsive stopping power.

Practical conveniences abound with the SecuriCode keyless-entry keypad on the driver's side, automatic temperature control split between front and rear zones, and rain-sensing wipers that adjust to weather conditions. The twin panel moonroof floods the cabin with natural light and fresh air, while the compass and outside temperature display add useful functionality.

This 2026 F-150 Raptor combines work-ready capability with refined appointments that make every journey more enjoyable. We invite you to visit our showroom and experience this truck firsthand.

This 2025 GMC Sierra 3500HD Denali represents serious capability engineered for those who demand the best in heavy-duty performance and refined comfort.

- Duramax 6.6L V8 Turbodiesel with 470 hp and 975 lb-ft of torque
- Gooseneck/5th Wheel Prep Package for professional-grade towing
- Denali Reserve Package with power sunroof and Technology Package
- Trailer Tire Pressure Monitor Sensors with In-Vehicle Trailering App
- MultiPro Tailgate Audio System by Kicker
- Power-Retractable Assist Steps with LED perimeter lighting
- Bose Premium 7-Speaker Sound System
- SiriusXM 360L Trial Subscription
- HD Surround Vision with Bed View Camera and trailer camera provisions
- Wireless Phone Projection and Wireless Charging
- Heated and ventilated front seats with memory settings
- Dual 220-Amp Primary and 170-Amp Auxiliary Alternators
- 20" Ultra-Bright Machined Alloy Wheels
- X31 Off-Road Package with 2-Speed Active Transfer Case
- Spray-On Pickup Bedliner with GMC Logo

The Duramax diesel engine delivers the torque you need for heavy loads, paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission and genuine 4WD capability. Whether you're managing worksite operations or hauling a gooseneck trailer, this truck handles demanding tasks with confidence. The alternator system provides abundant electrical power for auxiliary equipment and accessories.

Inside, the Denali Reserve trim surrounds you with thoughtful luxury. Premium Forge perforated leather seats heat and ventilate to keep you comfortable throughout the day. The 15-inch color head-up display, wireless charging pad, and dual-zone automatic climate control create an environment that respects both the work and the worker. Advanced technology like HD Surround Vision and Trailer Side Blind Zone Alert keeps you aware and in control.

Trailering technology makes managing your load second nature. The integrated Trailer Tire Pressure Monitor Sensors, Hitch Guidance with Hitch View, and multiple camera provisions give you complete visibility and confidence when towing. The spray-on bedliner protects against the wear of daily use while the power-retractable assist steps make entry and exit effortless regardless of the workload.

From the signature Chrome Denali grille to the polished exhaust tip, the Titanium Rush Metallic exterior communicates capability and refinement. The LED cargo area lighting and roof marker lamps enhance both function and appearance. Every detail reflects the commitment to quality that defines this truck.

At just over 16,400 miles, this Sierra 3500HD remains virtually new with factory warranty coverage and all the benefits of a current-model truck. The Denali Reserve edition represents the intersection of professional-grade capability and premium comfort—a serious choice for serious work.

- 10-Speed Automatic transmission with 4WD

The auto-dimming rear camera mirror and 15-inch head-up display enhance visibility and reduce driver fatigue during extended drives.

Automatic emergency braking, forward collision alert, lane departure warning, rear cross traffic alert, and trailer side blind zone alert work together to protect you and your cargo. Ultrasonic front and rear park assist makes maneuvering easier in tight spaces, while the buckle-to-drive reminder reinforces safe habits every trip.

The AT4 trim elevates this Sierra with distinctive styling and off-road readiness. The Gloss Black grille and header, LED roof marker lamps, and winter grille cover ensure this truck looks as purposeful as it performs. The Off-Road Suspension and 2-Speed Active Transfer Case give you confidence navigating challenging terrain when the job demands it.

This 2024 Sierra 2500HD AT4 combines the legendary durability of the Duramax diesel with the refinement GMC owners expect. With 32,358 miles, this truck is ready to become part of your operation or adventure. We invite you to experience this capable machine firsthand—schedule your test drive today.

This 2024 GMC Sierra 2500 Denali Ultimate 4WD is the kind of truck that does not need much explaining once you see it in person. Finished in Onyx Black with an Alpine Umber interior, this Sierra has the exact look people want in a high end diesel truck. It is big, bold, loaded, and it has the presence of a truck that had a $100,150 original window sticker.

This is a one owner, local trade in with 60,733 miles, and it is a very nice truck. The previous owner clearly bought this one with the right equipment, and that shows the second you walk up to it. Onyx Black paint, Denali Ultimate trim, Duramax diesel power, high gloss black 22 inch wheels, power assist steps, and the Alpine Umber interior make this one feel special.

Under the hood is the Duramax 6.6L V8 turbo diesel paired with the Allison 10 speed automatic transmission and 4WD. This is the setup people want when they are buying a serious heavy duty truck. It has the power, torque, towing confidence, and road presence to handle work, trailers, long trips, equipment, campers, and everyday driving with ease.

This Sierra is equipped with the kind of heavy duty features truck buyers actually care about. It has an auto locking rear differential, 2 speed AutoTrac transfer case, trailer brake controller, trailering package, vehicle trailering app, gooseneck and fifth wheel package, hitch package, 7 pin trailer harness, bed view camera, spray on bedliner with logo, LED cargo lighting, MultiPro tailgate, power rear sliding window, roof marker lamps, and all terrain blackwall tires.

The Denali Ultimate interior is where this truck really separates itself. You get 16 way power front bucket seats, ventilated front seats, heated front seats, heated rear outboard seats, driver seat and mirror memory, Alpine Umber premium interior, leather wrapped steering wheel, 13.4 inch premium GMC infotainment screen with Google built in, wireless Apple CarPlay, wireless Android Auto, wireless charging, 12.3 inch color driver information center, Bose premium 12 speaker sound system, remote start, and open pore wood accents.

It is also packed with safety and driver assistance features, including Forward Collision Alert, Following Distance Indicator, Front Pedestrian Braking, Lane Departure Warning, Rear Cross Traffic Alert, Trailer Side Blind Zone Alert, HD Surround Vision, front and rear park assist, Safety Alert Seat, IntelliBeam automatic high beams, Stabilitrak with trailer sway control, and hill start assist.

As a hometown, family owned and operated dealership, this is exactly the kind of truck we get excited to show. It has the right story, one owner, local trade in, very nice condition, Duramax diesel power, Denali Ultimate luxury, serious towing equipment, and the kind of presence that makes people stop and look.

If you are looking for a heavy duty truck that feels like the top of the mountain, this 2024 GMC Sierra 2500 Denali Ultimate 4WD is the one to come see. It has the diesel, the luxury, the towing setup, the color, the wheels, and the original $100,150 build that make it stand out from the average truck.

This Rebel commands respect with its aggressive styling and purposeful design. The Black exterior with premium black diamond-cut wheels creates an authoritative presence, while the sport performance hood signals that this is no ordinary truck. This proven powerplant delivers the torque and reliability truck owners depend on, whether hauling heavy loads or navigating challenging terrain. The Rebel Suspension and electronic locking differential ensure you maintain control in demanding conditions. The engine block heater keeps your truck ready in cold weather, and dual 730-amp batteries provide dependable starting power year-round.

Your comfort matters on long drives or job site days. The leather-trimmed bucket seats keep you supported and comfortable, with heating and cooling functions that adjust to the season. The heated steering wheel warms your hands in winter, while the front seats ventilate during warm weather. The heated rear seats extend comfort to your passengers. The power-adjustable driver's seat with memory settings lets you find your perfect position every time.

Technology integration keeps you connected and in control. The Uconnect 5 Nav system features a 12.0-inch touchscreen with GPS navigation, Apple CarPlay, and Android Auto compatibility. SiriusXM satellite radio with 360L keeps entertainment flowing, while the premium 9-speaker Alpine audio system with subwoofer delivers rich sound quality. The integrated 4G LTE Wi-Fi hotspot keeps your devices connected, and Alexa built-in functionality adds voice control convenience.

Safety and visibility command attention with the Surround View Camera System and cargo view camera that work together to eliminate blind spots. Blind Spot and Cross Path Detection monitor your surroundings, while the Trailer Reverse Guidance system simplifies backing up with a trailer. Lane Departure Warning helps keep you centered, and adaptive cruise control maintains your desired distance from traffic ahead.

This one-owner Ram with a clean Carfax history is ready to serve you with the same reliability and performance it delivered to its original owner. The Towing Technology Group, Cold Weather Group, and Level 1 Equipment Group come standard, providing comprehensive capability without compromise. This is a truck built to work and equipped to perform.

Full-speed forward collision warning gives you critical seconds to react to obstacles ahead.

The 4WD system with 3.73 axle ratio delivers assured traction across varied terrain. LT275/70R18E all-terrain tires mount on 18-inch polished aluminum wheels, providing a balanced approach to both highway efficiency and off-road capability. Tow hooks and a rear step bumper complete the functional exterior.

This 2024 Ram 2500 Laramie represents a truck built to go the distance, combining diesel efficiency with modern comfort and safety technology. We invite you to visit our showroom and experience this capable truck firsthand.

The power sunroof and overhead LED lighting create an open, welcoming atmosphere.

Safety features include Blind Spot and Cross Path Detection to increase awareness, along with electronic stability control and anti-lock braking. The ParkView Rear Back-Up Camera with integrated cargo view display simplifies maneuvering in tight spaces. Dual front and side airbags, along with overhead airbags, provide comprehensive protection for all passengers.

The Lunar Edition styling distinguishes this Power Wagon with its Gloss Black grille surround, accent color door handles, and blue interior accent stitching. The sport performance hood and Power Wagon badging reinforce this truck's serious capability. Mopar Black Tubular Side Steps provide both aesthetic appeal and functional assistance entering the cabin.

This well-equipped Power Wagon is ready for both daily driving and serious work. With its combination of advanced technology, safety features, comfort appointments, and off-road engineering, this truck serves multiple roles without compromise.

This 2024 GMC Sierra 1500 Denali arrives in White Frost Tricoat with a commanding presence and the capability to handle any task. The truck delivers genuine truck performance paired with refined luxury details that make every drive engaging. Key features include:

- EcoTec3 6.2L V8 engine with 420 horsepower and 460 lb-ft of torque
- Active Exhaust with dual-outlet, sport-mode capability
- Super Cruise semi-autonomous driving technology with wrapped steering wheel
- 22" painted aluminum wheels with machining and bright chrome inserts

- Denali Premium Suspension with adaptive ride control
- Power sunroof
- Premium Bose 7-speaker sound system with SiriusXM satellite radio
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility
- Heated and ventilated front seats with 12-way power adjusters
- Heated rear seats
- Wireless Apple CarPlay and wireless Android Auto
- Integrated trailer brake controller with integrated trailering system app

The cabin reflects Denali craftsmanship with genuine wood appointments throughout the dashboard, console, and door panels. The spray-on bedliner bears the Denali logo, adding a premium touch to the truck bed. Leather seat trim, perforated and refined, wraps the front bucket seats, while the rear offers a split-folding design. Heated steering wheel, wireless charging, panoramic sunroof, and an 8-inch infotainment display with navigation system create an environment built for both command and comfort.

This certified vehicle has been thoroughly inspected and prepared to the highest standards. The comprehensive 134-point inspection process ensures mechanical soundness, safety systems functionality, and cosmetic quality. You receive a 12-month/12,000-mile bumper-to-bumper limited warranty following the manufacturer's coverage, providing extended peace of mind. The CARFAX Vehicle History Report provides full transparency about this truck's background, and the 7-day/500-mile exchange policy gives you confidence in your decision.

Technology is central to the driving experience. Super Cruise allows hands-free highway driving on compatible roadways. The truck bed view camera, rear camera mirror, and HD surround vision system enhance visibility and safety during parking and maneuvering. Lane keep assist with lane departure warning, forward collision alert with pedestrian braking, and rear cross-traffic braking add layers of protection. Ultrasonic front and rear park assist guides you into tight spaces.

Versatility comes standard. The integrated trailer brake controller, hitch guidance, hitch view, and in-vehicle trailering system app simplify towing tasks. Hill descent control aids in challenging terrain. The truck sits on a 3.23 rear axle ratio suited for both highway efficiency and load handling. Chrome recovery hooks and chrome wheel-to-wheel assist steps signal capability met with refinement.

This 2024 Sierra 1500 Denali combines truck authenticity with luxury amenities. It's ready for work, adventure, or daily driving. Contact us today to experience the difference a certified GMC truck delivers.
